title.narrative: Chongqing Innovation and Human Capital Development Project

description.narrative: The project is located in Chongqing, a centrally administered municipality in the Chengdu-Chongqing city cluster at the upper reaches of the Yangtze River. Chongqing's resource-based inefficient economy is impacting the environment, and it prioritizes innovation in promoting sustainable development to shift from heavily polluting industries to innovation-driven industries across all economic sectors. The project will (i) help the people in Chongqing gain industry-relevant and innovation-oriented skills and capacities for employment; and (ii) support institutions to create an enabling and inclusive environment that helps build an innovative, diversified, efficient, and green economy in Chongqing.

Based on the BOPPPS effective teaching structure as the classroom teaching design paradigm, a training process of "theoretical prompts + micro-lesson demonstrations + peer feedback + expert guidance + self-reflection" was formed, constructing a training model with five small cycles per day, three large cycles in three days, focusing on phenomena, analyzing problems, emphasizing effectiveness, and promoting development. A total of 20 people participated in our school, including 16 women, accounting for 80%.

A total of 57 teachers from CUE participated in these activities, among which 29 were female teachers. Through the above thematic training sessions and seminars, the level of discipline construction and the quality of school operation have been further improved, fully leveraging the advantages in scientific research and enhancing the quality of talent cultivation. These activities included attending a seminar on digital transformation and industry integration for logistics majors, participating in discussions on "Golden Teaching Materials" by the Chongqing Higher Vocational and Technical Education Research Association, engaging in a workshop on empowering and enhancing artificial intelligence education in higher education, attending special lectures, exchanging and learning at Chongqing Coal Research Institute Co., Ltd., and Chongqing Chang'an Automobile Co., Ltd., as well as teachers participating in teaching capability training, along with six enterprise visits for docking and learning. Output: Supporting mechanisms for innovation and entrepreneurship established Indicator: Two one-stop service stations offering public services relating to business start-ups, job information, and social services for people including local workers and returning migrants established Achievement: 0 Progress/Status: The one-stop stations will offer public services relating to business start-ups, job opportunities, and social services (including for female) in the public service areas of the project constructed buildings. The civil works contract of DJ-CW01 for Dianjiang was awarded and approved by ADB in Q2 of 2023. In the third quarter of 2024, the civil engineering contracts CS-CW01 and CS-CW02 in Changshou were signed and approved by ADB. Changshou plans to use domestic procurement to have the CS-E02 innovation service platform. Changshou plans to select a one-stop technology service platform supplier through competition. Changshou will develop an intelligent park office management system, relying on domestic one-stop technology service platform, by procurement of innovative platform services. On the one hand, Changshou will use the innovation platform to provide one-stop technological innovation services for small and medium-sized science and technology enterprises such as technological resources, policy funds, and project in-depth consultation, to reduce innovation costs, improve product performance and shorten the R&D cycle. On the other hand, Changshou will use the innovation platform to provide advisory services for Changshou ETDA, focusing on industries and enterprises of Changshou ETDA, begin study of the industries, and service institutions, and propose development ideas, operation mechanism and market model for a technology transfer service system. Changshou will design the scheme for conversion of scientific and technological achievements in line with the actual situation of Changshou ETDA and create a characteristic ecosystem of regional technological innovation service. In July / August 2024, the civil engineering contracts CS-CW01 and CS-CW02 in Changshou were signed. The construction preparation has been completed. The construction period is 15/18 months.
Returning migrants' Entrepreneurship and Employment Comprehensive Building of DJ-CW01 will provide one-stop public service for all returning migrants in Dianjiang, including employment guidance, training, policy consultation, business taxation, entrepreneurship consultation etc. People served will include the personnel of the project as well as other returning migrants in Dianjiang County. The civil works contract of DJ-CW01 for Dianjiang was awarded in May 2023, however, the construction on site was suspended after the completion of temporary facilities. In August 2024, the variation for the adjustment of construction site was approved by ADB. The construction resumed in early September 2024 and expected to be completed in June 2026. DJ-S02 service system design for employment will include experts in one-stop public services system design and recruitment will start in 2025. Data Source: ETDAs' periodic reports and project progress reports
